title: Skill Activation/Workflow Evaluation Case
description: One test case for whether a skill should activate and how it should behave once active.

id.description: Unique, kebab-case, prefixed with the skill name, e.g. debugging-investigator-pos-01.

skill.description: Directory name of the skill under skills/ this case belongs to.

category.description: positive-obvious: clear trigger. positive-ambiguous: indirect/hard trigger. negative: must NOT activate.

prompt.description: The user message this case evaluates activation against.

required_behaviors.description: Observable workflow steps or artifacts the agent must produce when the skill activates.

forbidden_behaviors.description: Behaviors that indicate the skill was ignored or misapplied (e.g. 'jumps to a fix before reproducing').

expected_artifacts.description: Output files/sections the skill's output contract requires, e.g. DEBUG_REPORT.md.

route_to.description: Negative cases only: the skill this prompt belongs to instead. run_routing_evals.py gates that this skill outranks the case's own skill.

notes.description: Why this case is included, especially for ambiguous/negative cases.
